lines.t: No church named a man is the true church, not one
No church named a man is the true church, not one
Who believes in the Messiah and obeys
His voice in whom the Spirit dwells
Make up the true church of his body
True, true, true, true, true, true, true
Church, named a man, is the true church, not one.
No, church, named a man, is the true church, not one.
One, one, one, one, one, says the Lord.
